data.situation:
At twenty to twelve, the researcher led Lin and Maya to the periodical shelf. A quarterly periodical lay open beside her earlier article. Lin turned to its bibliography and found a book about how people read labels. Maya looked at the methods section to see how the readers had been chosen. The researcher also showed them an anonymised example from a completed peer review, which the journal had permitted her to use for teaching. Two specialists in her field had asked for more detail about the way she selected participants; their names and identifying details had been removed. Their questions had called for greater rigour in the explanation, and she showed how her final revision addressed them. Maya wrote the book title on a slip of paper. Lin marked the library catalogue number, then carried the note back to the window table. PERMITTED TEACHING EXAMPLE — COMPLETED PEER REVIEW
Anonymised comments and revision notes, shared with the journal's permission.
Explain how participants were selected in the methods section. Add the missing reference to the bibliography. The description needs greater rigour; it should say exactly what happened during each reading session.
Revision note: I added the selection criteria and the missing reference before publication. No reviewer or participant identities are included in this teaching copy.

readingBlocks.zh: 十一点四十分，研究者带林和玛雅来到期刊架。一份季刊摊在她以前的一篇文章旁边。林翻到参考文献页，找到一本关于人们如何阅读标签的书。玛雅查看方法部分，想了解读者是怎么选出来的。研究者还给她们看了一个已完成同行评审的匿名示例，期刊已允许她用于教学。同领域的两位专家曾要求她更详细地说明参与者的选择方法；示例已去掉姓名和可识别身份的细节。这些问题要求解释更严谨，她展示了最终修改怎样回应这些意见。玛雅把书名写在一张纸条上，林标出图书馆检索号，随后带着纸条回到窗边桌。

readingBlocks.zh:
获准用于教学的示例——已完成的同行评审
匿名评语与修改记录，经期刊许可分享。
在方法部分说明如何选择参与者。把漏掉的文献补入参考文献表。描述需要更严谨，应准确写出每次阅读观察中实际发生了什么。
修改记录：发表前，我补充了选择标准和漏掉的文献。这份教学副本不含评审者或参与者的身份信息。

glossary.zh: 作品末列出的参考文献或相关书目
glossary.note: bibliography为文章列出的参考文献表，书名可据此再检索。
glossary.example: Lin turned to its bibliography and found a book about how people read labels.
glossary.exampleZh: 林翻到参考文献页，找到一本关于人们如何阅读标签的书。

externalEvidence.definition: a list of writings with time and place of publication (such as the writings of a single author or the works referred to in preparing a document etc.)

glossary.note: periodical为定期出版的刊物；本句a quarterly periodical指季刊，名词。
glossary.example: A quarterly periodical lay open beside her earlier article.
glossary.exampleZh: 一份季刊摊在她以前的一篇文章旁边。

externalEvidence.definition: a publication that appears at fixed intervals

glossary.zh: 报告或书中的一部分（名词）
glossary.note: methods section为文章的方法部分，section不是路段或切片。
glossary.example: Maya looked at the methods section to see how the readers had been chosen.
glossary.exampleZh: 玛雅查看方法部分，想了解读者是怎么选出来的。

externalEvidence.definition: a self-contained part of a larger composition (written or musical)

glossary.zh: 由相关领域专业同行对研究稿进行评审
glossary.note: peer review在此为同领域专家审查研究稿，不是Lin/Maya互看作业。
glossary.example: The researcher also showed them an anonymised example from a completed peer review, which the journal had permitted her to use for teaching.
glossary.exampleZh: 研究者还给她们看了一个已完成同行评审的匿名示例，期刊已允许她用于教学。

externalEvidence.label: Collins English Dictionary

glossary.zh: 方法或论证严格而仔细的严谨性
glossary.note: greater rigour指描述更准确、严谨；不是对学生态度苛刻。

glossary.exampleZh: 这些问题要求解释更严谨，她展示了最终修改怎样回应这些意见。

externalEvidence.definition: the quality of being valid and rigorous
